text:
Elena: quick ping — need panel coverage for candidate B, Thurs 3pm PT. Role is infra-heavy, so we need 2 interviewers + 1 scribe. Also proposing a rubric exception: bump system-design weight to 40% for this one. can folks confirm availability and any objections to the weighting?
Samir: I can take an interviewer slot. happy to focus on scaling + ops questions. :thumbsup:
Priya: I can scribe. where should I capture notes? link?
Elena: use the Candidate Notes template in the shared debriefs folder: https://redwood-internal/notes/debriefs/candB — I added a header called "Context: take-home timing" — if take-home was late, note it under context (don’t auto-penalize unless missing work).
Jordan: small q — are we still on a 1–4 live scale? i vaguely remember convo about 1–5. want to be consistent.
Mira: short answer: we keep 1–4 for live sessions, 1–5 for take-homes. for this panel, treat system-design as 1–4. if unsure, leave a note in the comment field so we can normalize during calibration.
Samir: noted. one other nuance: if candidate proposes an unconventional but sound design, give partial credit and annotate tradeoffs. don't zero it out for not matching our exact example.
Elena: exactly — please add a short justification when giving partial credit. paste for the notes header you can copy:
```
Rubric adjustments for candidate B (infra role):
- System design weight: 40%
- Implementation/problem solving: 35%
- Communication/culture fit: 25%
Guidance: award partial credit for reasonable alternative designs and annotate tradeoffs.
```
people-ops-bot: Reminder: submit debrief within 24h after interview. Use `/debrief submit --thread 1751112222` or upload to the doc link above.
Priya: noted, I'll set the shared doc and add timestamps + scribe template. I'll also leave a 10-min buffer after the interview for quick triage.
Jordan: good to me. no blockers from my side.
Elena: thanks all — marking confirmed: Samir (interviewer), Jordan (interviewer), Priya (scribe). ping me if anything changes. :pray:
